stem: A supervisor wants to keep using a damaged ladder because no replacement is immediately available. What is the strongest decision?
choices: Remove the damaged ladder from service and use an approved alternative work method or delay the task until safe access is available
Use the ladder only for experienced workers
Place a warning sign on the ladder and continue
Limit use to short tasks so the damage matters less
rationale: Known defective access equipment should not remain in service; scheduling pressure does not justify accepting a preventable fall hazard.
